summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares glufosfamide with fluorouracil (5-FU) in people with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma whose disease got worse during or after gemcitabine treatment. Glufosfamide is given by IV infusion over 6 hours on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle, and 5-FU is given by IV over 30 minutes on Day 1 of each week. The study aims to assess whether glufosfamide provides additional survival benefit compared with 5-FU.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 compara glufosfamida con fluorouracilo (5-FU) en personas con adenocarcinoma pancreático metastásico cuya enfermedad empeoró durante o después del tratamiento con gemcitabina. La glufosfamida se administra por infusión intravenosa durante 6 horas el Día 1 de cada ciclo de 21 días, y el 5-FU se administra por vía intravenosa durante 30 minutos el Día 1 de cada semana. El estudio busca evaluar si la glufosfamida ofrece un beneficio adicional en la supervivencia en comparación con el 5-FU.
who_for: Pancreatic adenocarcinoma confirmed by biopsy or cytology
Disease progression during or after gemcitabine-based treatment
not_for: More than one prior systemic therapy regimen for metastatic pancreatic cancer
Cardiovascular disease within the past year (NYHA Class 2 to 4)
Hemoglobin below 9 g/dL, or creatinine clearance below 60 mL/min
